::: {#def-statistical-model .theorem}
## Statistical model

A collection of probability distributions $\mathbb{M}$ on the range of a vector of random variables $\mathbf{V}$, indexed by a parameter $\theta$, each of which may describe the behaviour of $\mathbf{V}$:

$$
\mathbb{M}=\{P_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}.
$$
:::
